bio: I build software for security and internal business workflows. At Williams-Sonoma, I work on the enterprise service desk supporting 600+ retail stores, troubleshooting Windows, POS, and network issues through ServiceNow. My personal projects connect that operational experience with Python APIs, security automation, and identity detection. Current lab work brings together PostgreSQL, alert triage, and synthetic employee onboarding and rehire scenarios. Public projects include Sigma detection rules, Okta identity detections, a SOAR-style orchestrator, and desktop tools. I hold a BS in Computer Science and an MS in Cybersecurity and Information Assurance. Based in Sacramento; outside work, I'm usually camping, mountain biking, or spending time with my dogs.
targetRoles: Interested in software engineering for internal tools, backend development, security automation, and identity-focused roles. Sacramento or remote.
